spec: SPEC-PROOF-BATCH.md, proof-batch wire format v2 (sparse-VN edition)
publicValuesEncoding: alloy SolValue::abi_encode(&ProofBatch) == Solidity abi.encode(batch); a dynamic struct, so the first word is the offset 0x20
outputRoot: keccak256(bytes32(0) || stateRoot || messagePasserStorageRoot || blockHash); derived, not on the wire. See output-root-vectors.json.

cases.name: empty-batch-invalid
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[] is empty

cases.name: wrong-version-0x01
cases.expectedError: bad version 1, want 2 (v1 is retired: refuse, do not adapt)

cases.name: abi-garbage
cases.expectedError: public_values is not a valid ProofBatch ABI encoding

cases.name: non-contiguous-blocks
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[1] number 5000003, expected 5000002

cases.name: duplicate-block-number
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[1] number 5000001, expected 5000002

cases.name: equal-timestamps
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[1] timestamp 1800500000, must exceed 1800500000

cases.name: decreasing-timestamps
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[1] timestamp 1800500002, must exceed 1800500004

cases.name: duplicate-log-index
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[0].logs[1] logIndex 3, must exceed 3

cases.name: decreasing-log-index
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[0].logs[1] logIndex 4, must exceed 5

cases.name: bad-preimage-hash
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[0].logs[0] preimage hashes to 0x61d6138b161ac0a94e345e1f3c4a2f908630b8eb12d91c58fe670193f90cbe99, but logHash is 0xe862844726e267ebf46bcaee3a541b771a6c821808e87a497136d94f3cc5b09f

cases.name: short-preimage
cases.expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[0].logs[0] preimage is 19 bytes, must be 0 (absent) or at least 20 (address-prefixed)

generative.name: max-realistic-300-blocks
generative.description: 300 blocks — exactly one 10-minute proof-batch cadence at 2 s block time — with 0/1/2 logs per block, 300 logs total, no preimages. The size case: this is what a production envelope looks like on wire v2. Not stored; build it from the recipe and check envelopeKeccak.

recipe.scalars: keccak256("cove-fixture:max-realistic-300-blocks:<field>") for prevOutputRoot, l1Head, rollupConfigHash, depSetHash; exportPolicyHash is the v2 default (keccak256("cove-export-v2:all-hashes")); newOutputRoot is NOT synthetic — it is the derived output root of the LAST block (decision D11)
recipe.blocks: for i in 0..300: blockNumber = 9000001 + i, timestamp = 1800200000 + 2*i, and blockHash / stateRoot / messagePasserStorageRoot = keccak256("cove-fixture:max-realistic-300-blocks:<blockNumber>:<field>")
recipe.logs: for j in 0..(i % 3): logIndex = j, logHash = keccak256("cove-fixture:max-realistic-300-blocks:log:<i>:<j>"), preimage empty

generative.sizeNote: v2 costs 256 bytes per block plus 160 per exported log, against v1's 160 + 32. A log-free 300-block cadence is 77 KB (v1: 48 KB); this worst case — every block exporting 0/1/2 logs — is the number above, and it still fits a single blob. Chain P exports about one log per cadence in practice, so the operating point is the 77 KB end. Preimage-bearing policies add the preimage length per log, padded to 32.
